name: Folic acid
aliases: folic acid, folate, vitamin B9, vitamin B-9, pteroylmonoglutamic acid, folacin, ácido fólico, folato, acide folique, Folsäure, acido folico
what_is: Folic acid is vitamin B9. When it appears on a food label, it has normally been added to enrich or fortify the product with this vitamin.
why_botia: In an intervention with around 247,831 women who took 400 µg of folic acid a day around conception, neural tube defects in the baby fell by between 41% and 85% depending on the region.
can_1: Detect folic acid, folate and vitamin B9 when they are declared on the label.
can_2: Explain what the intervention found and show the Woman information layer.
cannot_1: Determine how much folic acid a food contains when the amount is not declared.
cannot_2: Tell anyone whether to take folic acid, or replace advice from a doctor or a midwife.

sources.label: Berry et al., NEJM 1999 — folic acid and prevention of neural tube defects

title: Folic acid
description: Folic acid is vitamin B9, normally added to foods to fortify them. In an intervention with around 247,831 women taking 400 µg a day around conception, neural tube defects in the baby fell by between 41% and 85% depending on the region.
